blocklist_shared.title: Non-bee insects are important contributors to global crop pollination

exclusions_and_limits: Unknown or generic publication strings never create edges.
A parseable DOI is not necessarily a correct DOI; only the reviewed cross-group allowlist creates DOI edges.
No grouping by shared individual name, email, affiliation, or generic funding body.
A common original publication is sufficient for a deliberately conservative source block, not proof that its fields are statistically dependent.
Different original publications may reuse fields or derive from the same programme; an original DOI graph alone is incomplete.
Country or crop differences do not break a verified shared original source component.
Do not infer held-out response standardization from the component grouping. That is a separate prediction-design question.
purpose: Provisional held-out source grouping for the pinned CropPol v2.1.0 field file. Membership is a provenance blocking rule, not a claim of statistical independence.
